summary: Summoning of additional accused under Section 319 Cr.P.C; standard: evidence must meet heightened threshold beyond prima facie but short of conviction; Hardeep Singh precedent on 'strong and cogent evidence'; High Court erred in relying solely on FIR allegations without new evidence; trial court dismissal of application upheld; absence of material post-investigation against appellants confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.304B, s.498A, s.406, s.323, s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order summoning additional accused set aside; trial court's dismissal of Section 319 application restored.
